payload.title: Knowledge run previews bulk writes before they go live
payload.description: After 1,366 mostly junk wiki pages reached Machines on Machines on 11-02. A site's first knowledge run produces a preview (what it would publish, a sample by kind) for a person to approve before writing. Later runs proceed unless output differs sharply from the site's own history, using a learned comparison, not a fixed cap. Ryan approved 11-02: knowledge-run rollouts to more sites hold until this and the run-id story are done. Gherkin specs.
